item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"rule":"The procedure adaptively ensured the ace of spades survived: if the initial pair contained it, that pair remained; otherwise that pair was discarded. In the final pair, tapping the ace of spades kept it, while tapping the other card discarded that card."}
